clue.text: The solution's found right after a news broadcast

definitions.note: the solution's is read as the solution is, the 's being a link

indicators.note: after places the letter for right at the end, following the rearranged letters
broadcast suggests something scattered about, so the letters of a news are spread and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone learns the result immediately after hearing a news bulletin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' turns A NEWS into ANSWE; 'after' puts R behind it. The 's on solution reads as 'is', leading into the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: The reply to a question or puzzle is its solution, so the two words are synonyms.

clue.text: This bean may be used to make a liqueur

indicators.note: the letters of this bean are used as raw material to make something new, signalling a rearrangement

explanation.surface: A recipe note explaining that a certain bean goes into a liqueur.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may be used to make' rearranges the eight letters of THIS BEAN; no bean is actually involved.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a green, aniseed-flavoured spirit distilled with wormwood, a type of strong liqueur.

clue.text: Pack for a traveller not wanting to attract notice

definitions.meaning: to pack is to put things away in storage, as luggage is put out of sight

definitions.text: a traveller not wanting to attract notice
definitions.meaning: someone hiding aboard a ship or plane to travel without paying

explanation.definitionFit: To pack things is to put them neatly out of the way; a hidden traveller without a ticket is the noun formed from that phrase.

clue.text: Some cynics believe nobody is on the level

indicators.note: some marks only part of the run of words, so the letters lie within cynics believe nobody

explanation.surface: A remark that certain cynics are so jaded they trust nobody to be honest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Some' signals that the letters sit inside the words: they straddle the end of 'believe' and the start of 'nobody'.
explanation.definitionFit: Something level is flat and smooth, with no bumps, which is exactly the meaning of the answer.

clue.text: A restorative that's not for universal use

definitions.meaning: a remedy aimed at one particular disease, an old medical sense of the word
limited to one particular case rather than general

explanation.definitionFit: Old medicine called a remedy for one particular ailment by this name; as an adjective it means particular rather than general.

clue.text: Pert, and prone perhaps to appear more important

indicators.note: perhaps suggests the letters of pert, and, prone might appear in another order

explanation.surface: A cheeky person lying down somehow seems superior to others.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' rearranges all twelve letters of PERT AND PRONE; 'to appear' leads to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that predominates outweighs the rest in influence or significance, so it is greater in importance.

clue.text: Firm on back-street producing beds

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm

indicators.note: back tells us to turn the abbreviation for street round so it reads in the other direction

explanation.surface: A business on a back street that manufactures beds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back-street' looks like a single description of a seedy location, but 'back' reverses ST to give TS, placed after CO.
explanation.definitionFit: Small beds for babies or campers, with sides or folding frames, are called by this name.

clue.text: End with a bit of fish and a drink

parts.note: a fin is part of a fish's body
ale is a type of beer, a drink

explanation.surface: Someone rounds off a meal with a morsel of fish and a beverage.
explanation.definitionFit: The closing part of a show or piece of music is its last movement or number.

clue.text: Reflected when many made cuts

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, a crossword convention for many
to hew is to chop or cut with an axe

explanation.surface: A thought about a time when lots of people made cuts, perhaps job cuts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'many' is a crossword convention for C, the Roman hundred.
explanation.definitionFit: Mulled over: to ponder something deliberately is said idiomatically as to chew it over.

clue.text: Husbands rushed on board

indicators.note: on board is read as aboard ship, so the word for rushed sits inside the two letters for a steamship

parts.note: SS stands for steamship, the vessel one goes on board
tore means rushed, moved at great speed

explanation.surface: Husbands hurried onto a ship or train.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on board' is the crossword convention of putting something inside SS, the abbreviation for steamship. 'Husbands' is a verb, meaning keeps in reserve.
explanation.definitionFit: To husband resources is to save them up for later, to lay them by.

clue.text: A few words addressed in French to the church

parts.note: a letter that is addressed is sent to someone
en is French for in
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A short message written in French to a church.
explanation.walkthrough: CE (Church of England) is a common crossword abbreviation for church.
explanation.definitionFit: A grammatical unit is a short group of words that makes a complete statement.

clue.text: Having no power without justification? Preposterous!

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the word for having no power goes round the other word

parts.note: unable means lacking the power to do something
a reason is a justification for an action

explanation.surface: Someone complains that a powerless person is acting without grounds, which is absurd.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like 'lacking', but here it means 'outside': UNABLE is wrapped round REASON.
explanation.definitionFit: Something outrageous goes beyond what good sense allows, which the answer means.

clue.text: Ham was doubtless served at his table

definitions.text: Ham was doubtless served at his table

parts.words: Ham was doubtless served at his table
parts.note: Ham, which looks like the meat, is the name of a son of the Bible's ark-builder, who sat at his father's table

explanation.walkthrough: In Genesis, Ham is one of the three sons of the patriarch who built the ark.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical patriarch fathered Ham, Shem and Japheth, so Ham would naturally eat at his table.

clue.text: Diplomat holding opposition leader in grudging regard

indicators.note: in places the first letter of opposition within the word for grudging regard

parts.note: envy is resentful admiration of what another has

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A diplomat privately admires, with resentment, the leader of the opposition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leader' picks O from 'opposition'; 'in' puts it inside ENVY, and 'holding' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An ambassador or emissary sent abroad on government business is a type of diplomat.

clue.text: Spend unwisely, being dispirited

definitions.meaning: an old British slang verb meaning to squander money, also spelt with a w

explanation.definitionFit: Slang for squandering cash (blow it); the colour also means melancholy, sad.

clue.text: Bore was not given a seat

definitions.meaning: bore here is the past tense of bear, meaning tolerated or put up with
remained upright on one's feet rather than sitting

explanation.definitionFit: Tolerated: to bear something is to put up with it; someone without a chair remained upright.

clue.text: Insertion of popular song

parts.note: in means fashionable, popular
a lay is a ballad or song

explanation.surface: A hit tune that gets slotted into something.
explanation.definitionFit: Material set into a surface, as in decorative woodwork, is an insertion.

clue.text: Fashion is in a sense agonising

indicators.note: is in tells us the word for fashion sits inside the word for one of the five senses

parts.note: hearing is one of the five senses
a trend is a fashion

explanation.surface: Being fashionable is, in a way, painful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a sense' looks like 'in a way' but is HEARING; 'is in' puts TREND inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Something agonising causes deep grief, so it breaks the heart.

clue.text: Where chirpy creatures may well be seen behind bars

definitions.text: Where chirpy creatures may well be seen behind bars

parts.words: Where chirpy creatures may well be seen behind bars
parts.note: suggests cheerful convicts in prison, but describes singing pets in a wire enclosure

explanation.walkthrough: 'chirpy' and 'behind bars' suggest a cheerful prisoner; the creatures are songbirds kept as pets.
explanation.definitionFit: A wire enclosure with bars keeps pet songbirds that chirp.

clue.text: Such a residence is not for women — in principle

indicators.note: in tells us one piece goes inside the word for principle

parts.note: a tenet is a principle or belief
a sign reading men marks a place not for women

explanation.surface: A building where women may not live, at least in theory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not for women' gives MEN, as on a toilet door; 'in' places it inside TENET.
explanation.definitionFit: A large block of rented flats, often crowded, is a type of residence.

clue.text: Prudent means of raising money — one kept in reserve!

indicators.note: kept in puts the tax and the numeral inside the verb for keeping in store

parts.note: to conserve is to keep in reserve, save
VAT, value added tax, is a British sales tax that raises money for government
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A careful way of fundraising, with a single item held back in reserve.
explanation.walkthrough: VAT is value added tax, a British sales tax; 'kept in' places VAT and I inside CONSERVE.
explanation.definitionFit: A cautious, careful person avoids risk and change, as a prudent one does.

clue.text: He covers personal support or he is in trouble

indicators.note: in trouble suggests the letters of or he is are in a mess and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: A man protects his own backers, or else he faces trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'personal support' is one's legs; the answer sells socks and stockings to cover them. 'in trouble' rearranges OR HE IS.
explanation.definitionFit: A dealer in stockings and socks supplies coverings for the legs, the body's own support.

clue.text: Time to add condiments

definitions.meaning: a period of the year such as summer or the football calendar
to flavour food with salt, pepper or spices

explanation.definitionFit: A part of the year, such as spring, is a period of time; adding salt and pepper flavours food.

clue.text: Duck enclosure without fencing

parts.note: a duck is a score of nothing in cricket, so O
a pen is an enclosure for animals

explanation.surface: A duck's enclosure with no fence around it.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a duck is a score of zero, so it gives O.
explanation.definitionFit: Land not fenced off is unenclosed, freely accessible.

clue.text: Annie's get-up is really silly

indicators.note: a get-up is an outfit, so the name Annie is dressed up in a new arrangement of its letters

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: Annie's outfit is ridiculous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'get-up' rearranges the letters of ANNIE; the possessive adds no letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Something pointless and empty-headed is foolish, very silly.

clue.text: Sluggish tributary of the Trent

definitions.meaning: a river in Nottinghamshire, England, that flows into the Trent, a major river of the English Midlands

explanation.definitionFit: Lazy and inactive describes a sluggish person; it is also the name of a small Nottinghamshire river feeding the Trent.

clue.text: Up-country there's a large expanse of water

indicators.note: in a down entry up means read from the bottom upwards, so the country is written backwards

parts.note: Eire is the Irish name for Ireland

explanation.surface: In the backwoods there is a big lake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Up' in a down clue reverses EIRE, the Irish name for Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: One of the five Great Lakes of North America, a vast expanse of fresh water.

clue.text: Judicious manner

definitions.meaning: an old word for way or manner, surviving in phrases like in no such way

explanation.definitionFit: A sensible, prudent person shows good judgement; the archaic noun means way or fashion.

clue.text: Letter written in quarters — copy retained

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: retained means kept inside, so the word for copy sits between the two compass points

parts.note: S and E are compass points, quarters of the compass
to crib is to copy, as from another pupil

explanation.surface: A letter written while in lodgings, with a copy kept.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Letter' is a verb, to put letters on something. 'quarters' gives two compass points, S and E; 'retained' holds CRIB between them, and 'written' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To engrave or write letters on a surface is to letter it.

clue.text: Gives a different look to the face

indicators.note: giving the letters of gives a a different look means rearranging them

explanation.surface: A makeover changes the appearance of someone's face.
explanation.walkthrough: 'different look' rearranges GIVES A; 'to' links to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A literary word for a person's face or features.

clue.text: Carried out, plastered

definitions.meaning: performed or delivered, as a service is
coated a wall with a first layer of plaster

explanation.definitionFit: A service delivered has been performed; in building, a wall coated with plaster or cement has been given that coat.

clue.text: Note and coin newly issued

parts.note: re is the second note of the sol-fa scale
a cent is a coin

explanation.surface: A banknote and a coin fresh from the mint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Note' suggests a banknote, but it is RE from do-re-mi.
explanation.definitionFit: Something lately issued is new and fresh, belonging to the near past.
